svg.aria-label: Pre-deployment, from first call to first shift, in two lanes. Assessment, timing varies by engagement: together, align on roles, shifts and site requirements; you share site requirements and name your point of contact; AFIMAC scopes timeline, costs and success measures and finalizes the deployment plan. Before the crew travels, can begin rapidly once approved: you arrange site access and badging, the shift plan and supervisor introductions, and workstations, equipment and consumables; AFIMAC sources and screens the crew, runs credential and role checks, books travel and housing, and completes site-specific safety onboarding. Day one morning: you badge the crew in and make supervisor introductions; AFIMAC arrives briefed, starts work and runs the day through your single point of contact.
